text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, the main character in the book
got a lot of
plushies too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No, not at all! It's like my dream came
true! I'm
really happy!
choice_data_list: ちょっと取りすぎたかな？
choice_data_list_en: Did I take a bit too much?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
And if I manage to carry all these back
home
without dropping one...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Think of the effect it'll have on my core
muscles!
Talk about two birds with one
stone!
